Tracked by #1115 and #1657.

Not forwarded (#1660 M1): in 0.13.0 the loader imported the vendored YAML parser (llm_rosetta._vendor.yaml.load) for its own use, and the inferred surface counts that import as a re-export. The compat module forwards the loader names 0.13.0 defined or re-exported from the shim layer; a YAML parser was never part of it.
